semantic.justification: Original currency numeric pattern, enabled fixed bank placement, negative-parenthesis merge, mixed/bank format list order, duplicate retention and default index. Materialized concatenations use actual UTF16 owners. Full native currency-pattern differential and SAL allocation/lifetime parity remain uncertified. B8TCAE restores the original public NfCurrencyEntry::GetEffectivePositiveFormat and GetEffectiveNegativeFormat scalar contracts declared in include/svl/zforlist.hxx. The existing pattern builder delegates to those same source responsibilities with original NF_BANKSYMBOL_FIX_POSITION=1 and UInt16 argument conversion. No immutable currency field or locale provider is replaced. An independent witness compiles unchanged original member bodies, original private parenthesis helper and original public declarations; only SAL_WARN logging is silenced.1936 native output rows span all defined placements, bank modes, diagnostic values and unsigned16 conversion boundaries. This establishes scalar placement results, not full native currency/formatter ABI, allocation or concurrency equivalence. Prior currency-owner counter maps are stale after this restoration and require recollection.
